Bug_Title: RANGE: Array offset is out of bounds (RANGE_ARRAY_OFFSET)
Bug_Details: Method is called with array parameter and offset parameter, but the offset is out of bounds. This will result in IndexOutOfBoundsException at runtime.
Bug_Explanation: The for loop in the'showBug' method is iterating from 0 to 'offset' (inclusive) which can cause 'IndexOutOfBoundsException' as'result' array size is 'offset' but we are trying to access elements from 0 to 'offset'. It should iterate until 'i < offset'
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered by calling the'showBug' method with an array and an offset that is greater than the size of the array. This will cause an 'IndexOutOfBoundsException' at runtime.
